id./param/region/r025.pack|book_ie.bxon|784: "...Oh, what is it, traveler? What? You want to know about something that can reveal a true form?
id./param/region/r025.pack|book_ie.bxon|834: "Something that reveals true forms... Could you mean the Revealing herb? I have one.
id./param/region/r025.pack|book_ie.bxon|8e0: "I don't need it, so if you want it that much, take it. Here.
id./param/region/r025.pack|book_ie.bxon|994: You got the Revealing herb! Report to Tania in Lifecod!
id./param/region/r025.pack|book_ie.bxon|b60: I am Ishmauri. One who lives under the moonlight.
id./param/region/r025.pack|book_ie.bxon|bcc: One guided by fate... hear me. Those with a mission in my world cannot return to yours and are in trouble.
id./param/region/r025.pack|book_ie.bxon|cd4: The only link between this world and yours is the moonshadow window that appears by moonlight...
id./param/region/r025.pack|book_ie.bxon|d74: Someone is blocking night, so your world has stayed day for many days. For all, could you bring back the night?
id./param/region/r025.pack|book_ie.bxon|f10: I would like to respect your wishes, but you are the only one I can ask... For everyone's sake, could you bring back the night?
id./param/region/r025.pack|book_ie.bxon|10c: Thank you, child of man. The one blocking night's arrival should be somewhere in Trodain Castle...
id./param/region/r025.pack|book_ie.bxon|117: Please be careful. May the moon's protection be with you...
id./param/region/r025.pack|book_ie.bxon|1b8: Please be careful. May the moon's protection be with you...
id./param/region/r025.pack|book_ie.bxon|12f: "...Huh! I-I am the Emperor of Day!
id./param/region/r025.pack|book_ie.bxon|133: "While day lasts, the world is mine... That person gave me the otherworldly spell that swaps day and night!
id./param/region/r025.pack|book_ie.bxon|145: "The moment night comes, I cast Ranalute and return it to day... Just repeat this, and this world is mine forever!!
id./param/region/r025.pack|book_ie.bxon|155: "Now come out! I'll make you feel how great my power is!!
id./param/region/r025.pack|book_ie.bxon|175: "Uoooh... Regret... I took the world... but...
id./param/region/r025.pack|book_ie.bxon|17b: "But now... I can sleep... soundly... maybe...
id./param/region/r025.pack|book_ie.bxon|186: Thank you, child of man. Now night will finally come to your world as well.
id./param/region/r025.pack|book_ie.bxon|18f: When night falls, moonlight fills the air and the moonshadow window appears in Trodain Castle's library...
id./param/region/r025.pack|book_ie.bxon|19b: Those stranded in my world can return to their own and fulfill their missions. All thanks to you. Thank you...
id./param/region/r025.pack|book_ie.bxon|1aa: Your mission here is safely accomplished. But someday, whoever sent the Emperor of Day will stand before you...
id./param/region/r025.pack|book_ie.bxon|1ca: Moonlight casts the shadow of a window. This seems to be the moonshadow window linking worlds.
id./param/region/r025.pack|book_ie.bxon|1d5: Listening closely, you hear voices from the other side.
id./param/region/r025.pack|book_ie.bxon|1dc: "Hey, how long are you going to keep eating? The moonshadow window works now, so let's go home quickly!
id./param/region/r025.pack|book_ie.bxon|1e8: "Just a bit more... just a little more. ...Nom nom.
id./param/region/r025.pack|book_ie.bxon|205: Defeating Ojamaro returned the Colorstones' color to normal!
id./param/region/r025.pack|book_ie.bxon|20c: "Defeating that many monsters... you're stronger than you look. You remind me of a friend of mine.
id./param/region/r025.pack|book_ie.bxon|219: "Oops, no time for idle chat! I must hurry home and cure Lyla's illness!
id./param/region/r025.pack|book_ie.bxon|225: "Well then, traveler, thanks for everything. Come to the Yuval resting place later. I'll thank you properly then.
id./param/region/r025.pack|book_ie.bxon|23a: A pained voice can be heard.
id./param/region/r025.pack|book_ie.bxon|248: A pained voice can be heard.
id./param/region/r025.pack|book_ie.bxon|23e: "Cough cough... it hurts... Dear... help me...
id./param/region/r025.pack|book_ie.bxon|24c: "Huff, huff... it hurts... Dear... Dear, help me...
id./param/region/r025.pack|book_ie.bxon|261: "Hey, you strong-looking fella! Hear me out, will ya~!
id./param/region/r025.pack|book_ie.bxon|269: "It's terrible! Something terrible happened to our Colorstones!
id./param/region/r025.pack|book_ie.bxon|270: "I can't explain it well, but it's awful! At this rate, the quarry is finished!
id./param/region/r025.pack|book_ie.bxon|27b: "Please, fella! Defeat the monster boss somewhere in the quarry and restore the Colorstone quarry!
id./param/region/r025.pack|book_ie.bxon|298: "I'll give you something good if you help, so please! Help us~!
id./param/region/r025.pack|book_ie.bxon|2aa: "Thanks, fella! You're our only hope! When you defeat the monster boss in the quarry, tell me!
id./param/region/r025.pack|book_ie.bxon|2dd: "Well done to come, weakling! I am Queen Matilda!
id./param/region/r025.pack|book_ie.bxon|2e5: "The rockbombs born of the gem are my dear, dear servants! Destruction is my delight!
id./param/region/r025.pack|book_ie.bxon|2f1: "This quarry... and you! I shall destroy them! Hahaha! Let us begin!
id./param/region/r025.pack|book_ie.bxon|300: With Queen Matilda defeated, the Colorstones that had turned into rockbombs are returning to normal...!
id./param/region/r025.pack|book_ie.bxon|31a: You restored the Colorstones! Tell the man at the quarry entrance!
id./param/region/r025.pack|book_ie.bxon|336: "Ugh... my head feels like it's splitting. What was I doing...
id./param/region/r025.pack|book_ie.bxon|33c: "...My name is Matilda. I don't know what happened, but you saved me.
id./param/region/r025.pack|book_ie.bxon|348: "The other day, while patrolling the quarry, I met an unfamiliar monster. Then it said to me:
id./param/region/r025.pack|book_ie.bxon|357: "That is not the limit of your power. Destruction is surely your wish... it said.
id./param/region/r025.pack|book_ie.bxon|361: "I don't remember much after, but a strange spell was cast on me and I was changed into that terrible form.
id./param/region/r025.pack|book_ie.bxon|36e: "Driven by a destructive urge surging from within, I turned Colorstones into rockbombs... like a nightmare.
id./param/region/r025.pack|book_ie.bxon|37e: "But now I'm freed from that nightmare and back in human form. I'm glad my human heart remained.
id./param/region/r025.pack|book_ie.bxon|38d: "It seems it was all thanks to you, nameless traveler. Thank you truly for stopping me.
id./param/region/r025.pack|book_ie.bxon|3a9: "Nobody will do scary things to ya! Be a good kid and calm down!!
id./param/region/r025.pack|book_ie.bxon|3b2: "T-traveler, just in time! This one's rampaging and we can't handle it!! Please help!!
id./param/region/r025.pack|book_ie.bxon|3c9: "Thank goodness!! Sorry for the poor thing, but please whack it good and drive it off!!
id./param/region/r025.pack|book_ie.bxon|3e3: "Thank you for driving it off. But that one is trouble... It comes often lately and rampages.
id./param/region/r025.pack|book_ie.bxon|3ef: "It won't listen even when we try taming it, and our kids are terrified. Lapin House is in danger of closing!
id./param/region/r025.pack|book_ie.bxon|3fa: "Traveler, if you know an item that calms its heart so it goes 'meow,' could you fetch it?
id./param/region/r025.pack|book_ie.bxon|411: "Nyaa! Don't be cold, please! Whenever you find an item to calm it, bring it!
id./param/region/r025.pack|book_ie.bxon|42e: "Thanks, you saved me. I'm Karatchi, retainer to Lord Lapin who lives in this mansion.
id./param/region/r025.pack|book_ie.bxon|438: "Actually, I love killer panthers so much I can sort of understand their words...
id./param/region/r025.pack|book_ie.bxon|461: "Eek! You again?! Nobody will do scary things to ya! Be a good kid and calm down!!
id./param/region/r025.pack|book_ie.bxon|46e: "T-traveler, you came back! Did you get something to calm this one's heart!?
id./param/region/r025.pack|book_ie.bxon|4a0: "Is this pretty ribbon it?! Okay! I'll show it to him!!
id./param/region/r025.pack|book_ie.bxon|4a7: Karatchi held Bianca's ribbon before the killer panther!
id./param/region/r025.pack|book_ie.bxon|4ad: The killer panther sniffed Bianca's ribbon!
id./param/region/r025.pack|book_ie.bxon|4ba: "W-what was that? That one looked like it remembered where it belongs.
id./param/region/r025.pack|book_ie.bxon|4c7: "Maybe it was rampaging because it wanted to go home but couldn't. ...But it's all right now.
id./param/region/r025.pack|book_ie.bxon|4d2: "It went home to the one it loves. Thanks to you. Please take this as thanks.
id./param/region/r025.pack|book_ie.bxon|4df: "And, when parting, that killer panther left something like a password. I'll tell you that too.
id./param/region/r025.pack|book_ie.bxon|4f2: The Lapin House at Dusk from the Altar of the Cursed Princess seems to be unlocked.
id./param/region/r025.pack|book_ie.bxon|518: Rica received the book from Luida and read "The Mark of a King"!
id./param/region/r025.pack|book_ie.bxon|521: "A king must never lose sight of himself, no matter when.
id./param/region/r025.pack|book_ie.bxon|528: "A king is father to his people. As a father, he must never lose his pride.
id./param/region/r025.pack|book_ie.bxon|531: "If a father loses his pride, his children grieve. A father who grieves his children is unfit to be king.
id./param/region/r025.pack|book_ie.bxon|53d: "If a father loses his pride, his children grieve... huh.
id./param/region/r025.pack|book_ie.bxon|544: "Right, as innkeeper queen my pride is welcoming guests with a smile. If I lose that pride, guests will be sad.
id./param/region/r025.pack|book_ie.bxon|555: "If I'd kept making guests sad, I'd truly have lost my right as innkeeper queen. ...I'd forgotten something important.
id./param/region/r025.pack|book_ie.bxon|566: "Good. Rica noticed properly. Look at her bright expression.
id./param/region/r025.pack|book_ie.bxon|570: "Rica will be fine now. Thank you so much. Would you accept a thank-you from me?
id./param/region/r025.pack|book_ie.bxon|57c: "Bringing back a girl's smile may be small to you, but Rica's is a special smile that cheers everyone.
id./param/region/r025.pack|book_ie.bxon|5bc: "Pyaaa!! Feel the power of me, who ate the Goddess fruit! I'll destroy everything!!
id./param/region/r025.pack|book_ie.bxon|5cd: Amazingly, Endragon, Dragon of the End, turned into a slime!
id./param/region/r025.pack|book_ie.bxon|5f9: "But I got a bit carried away and rampaged too much, I think...
id./param/region/r025.pack|book_ie.bxon|601: "If I caused trouble, I'm sorry. I'll never do this again. Oh, I'll give this to you!
id./param/region/r025.pack|book_ie.bxon|60b: You got the Goddess fruit! Deliver it to Aquila in the Celestial Realm!
id./param/region/r025.pack|book_ie.bxon|645: "Mother!? Why are you in a place like this!? Could it be...
id./param/region/r025.pack|book_ie.bxon|64c: "You decided avenging Brother was impossible and came to take me home! No! I'm never going back.
id./param/region/r025.pack|book_ie.bxon|65a: "No matter what, I will avenge Brother. It's the path I believe in.
id./param/region/r025.pack|book_ie.bxon|668: "You really never listen to me. So stubborn, who do you take after?
id./param/region/r025.pack|book_ie.bxon|676: "You say that... but you're the one who never listens to me, Mother!
id./param/region/r025.pack|book_ie.bxon|682: "W-why are you laughing?! Mother, you always...
id./param/region/r025.pack|book_ie.bxon|689: "Thank you. This personality is indeed our Jessica. It's a humble gift, but please accept it.
id./param/region/r025.pack|book_ie.bxon|696: "Wait, what's going on? I don't understand any of this!
id./param/region/r025.pack|book_ie.bxon|69c: "Hehe. It's fine if you don't... Let me look at your face a bit longer.
id./param/region/r025.pack|book_ie.bxon|6ac: "Thank you so much. From Jessica's traveling friends I learned in detail that her odd behavior may be a monster's doing.
id./param/region/r025.pack|book_ie.bxon|6d7: {var:1} got the "Book of Humor"! Use it when needed!
id./param/region/r025.pack|book_ie.bxon|6f0: {var:1} got the "Tomboy Dictionary"! Use it when needed!
id./param/region/r025.pack|book_ie.bxon|714: "Hoho... another victim for my horn has appeared.
id./param/region/r025.pack|book_ie.bxon|71b: "I am Ultra Metal Kin! Ruler of this path of the unseen demon!
id./param/region/r025.pack|book_ie.bxon|725: "I never flee! I am the strongest Metal king slime, born by that person's power to take revenge on adventurers!
id./param/region/r025.pack|book_ie.bxon|734: "The humiliating era of being doggedly chased by greedy adventurers is over. Now it's the era I strike back!
id./param/region/r025.pack|book_ie.bxon|747: "As long as the treasure map here spreads among adventurers, my revenge shall not end!
id./param/region/r025.pack|book_ie.bxon|753: "Foolish adventurers who harbor the faint dream of gaining battle experience easily, I'll sweep them all away!
id./param/region/r025.pack|book_ie.bxon|76b: "N-no...! At this rate the spell will... break...
id./param/region/r025.pack|book_ie.bxon|770: "Waaah~~ this is bad! The fusion spell that person cast on us broke~~!
id./param/region/r025.pack|book_ie.bxon|77a: "Yikes, yikes~~! Now we can't use the amazing spells!
id./param/region/r025.pack|book_ie.bxon|785: The Metal king slimes ran away!
id./param/region/r025.pack|book_ie.bxon|788: You defeated Ultra Metal Kin, who tormented adventurers! Report to the warrior at the cave entrance!
id./param/region/r025.pack|book_ie.bxon|7fe: "The Water Folk: Wetlings" Free dwellers of beautiful sea islands, with bodies the blue of the water's surface.
id./param/region/r025.pack|book_ie.bxon|80e: Disliking restraint and treasuring song and love, they fought in earnest only to protect loved ones.
id./param/region/r025.pack|book_ie.bxon|828: "The Earth Folk: Dwarves" Dwellers of the mountains, with small bodies and large ears.
id./param/region/r025.pack|book_ie.bxon|839: With great technical skill and strong desires, they used their dexterity and speed to build many advanced civilizations.
id./param/region/r025.pack|book_ie.bxon|851: "The Wind Folk: Elves" Lovers of nature in the forest, lovely folk with small wings on their backs.
id./param/region/r025.pack|book_ie.bxon|85f: Valuing tradition and propriety, they studied the world's laws deeply and produced many masters of fine spells.
id./param/region/r025.pack|book_ie.bxon|877: "The Flower Folk: Pukulipo" Those who live seeking fun in storybook-colored towns, with small, fluffy, adorable bodies.
id./param/region/r025.pack|book_ie.bxon|886: Born with strong magic and dexterity, they devoted their passion to creating fun more than fighting or crafting.
id./param/region/r025.pack|book_ie.bxon|89c: "The Flame Folk: Ogres" Those who live strongly in harsh wastelands, large of body with horns and tails.
id./param/region/r025.pack|book_ie.bxon|8aa: Combative and respecting the strong, they fought with great strength, risking their lives for the weak and comrades.
id./param/region/r025.pack|book_ie.bxon|8c1: A green Colorstone. A small piece has been chipped away.
id./param/region/r025.pack|book_ie.bxon|8d7: Colorstones break easily, so handle with care.

tm.「……あら どうしたの 旅の方。\n え？ 正体をあばけるような物について\n: "...Oh, what is it, traveler? What? You want to know about something that can reveal a true form?
tm.「正体をあばけるような物……ねえ。\n もしかして アバキ草のことかしら。\n: "Something that reveals true forms... Could you mean the Revealing herb? I have one.
tm.「私には 必要ないものだし\n そんなに ほしいなら あなたにあげるわ。\n は: "I don't need it, so if you want it that much, take it. Here.
tm.アバキ草を 手に入れた！\nライフコッドにいる ターニアに\n報告しにいこう！: You got the Revealing herb! Report to Tania in Lifecod!
tm.私は イシュマウリ。\n月の光のもとに 生きる者。: I am Ishmauri. One who lives under the moonlight.
tm.運命に導かれし者よ…… 話を聞いてほしい。\n私の世界に来ている 使命ある者たち: One guided by fate... hear me. Those with a mission in my world cannot return to yours and are in trouble.
tm.こちらと そちらの世界を つなげるのは\n月の光によって現れる 月影の窓のみ……: The only link between this world and yours is the moonshadow window that appears by moonlight...
tm.しかし 何者かが 夜の訪れをはばんでいるため\nもう何日も そちらの世界は 昼の: Someone is blocking night, so your world has stayed day for many days. For all, could you bring back the night?
tm.君の意見を 尊重してあげたいが\n頼めそうな者は 君しかいない……。\nどうか: I would like to respect your wishes, but you are the only one I can ask... For everyone's sake, could you bring back the night?
tm.ありがとう 人の子よ。\n夜の訪れをはばんでいる者は\nトロデーン城のどこかに: Thank you, child of man. The one blocking night's arrival should be somewhere in Trodain Castle...
tm.くれぐれも気をつけて。\n月の加護が 君と ともにあらんことを……。: Please be careful. May the moon's protection be with you...
tm.「……はっ！\n わ…我は ひるのていおう！: "...Huh! I-I am the Emperor of Day!
tm.「昼が続く限り 世界は 我のもの……\n あの方は そう約束して 昼と夜を入れ替: "While day lasts, the world is mine... That person gave me the otherworldly spell that swaps day and night!
tm.「夜が来た瞬間に ラナルータと 呪文を唱えて\n 昼に戻す……。これを 繰り返す: "The moment night comes, I cast Ranalute and return it to day... Just repeat this, and this world is mine forever!!
tm.「さあ オモテに出ろ！\n 我のチカラが どれほど大きいか……\n その身体に: "Now come out! I'll make you feel how great my power is!!
tm.「ウォォォ……。\n 無念だ……。世界を 手に……し…たのに……。: "Uoooh... Regret... I took the world... but...
tm.「だが これで………\n ……ゆっくり 眠れる……か…………。: "But now... I can sleep... soundly... maybe...
tm.ありがとう 人の子よ。\nこれで ようやく そちらの世界にも\n夜が 訪れるよう: Thank you, child of man. Now night will finally come to your world as well.
tm.夜になれば 月の光が満ちて\nトロデーン城の図書室に 月影の窓が現れる……。: When night falls, moonlight fills the air and the moonshadow window appears in Trodain Castle's library...
tm.私の世界で 足留めされていた者たちも\n自分の世界へ帰って 使命を果たせるだろう: Those stranded in my world can return to their own and fulfill their missions. All thanks to you. Thank you...
tm.ここでの 君の使命は 無事に果たされた。\nだが ひるのていおうを 送り込んだ者: Your mission here is safely accomplished. But someday, whoever sent the Emperor of Day will stand before you...
tm.月の光が 窓の影を 作りだしている。\nこれが 世界をつなぐ 月影の窓のようだ。: Moonlight casts the shadow of a window. This seems to be the moonshadow window linking worlds.
tm.耳をすますと 向こう側から 話し声が聞こえる。: Listening closely, you hear voices from the other side.
tm.「おーい いつまで食ってるんだよ。\n 月影の窓が 使えるようになったんだから\: "Hey, how long are you going to keep eating? The moonshadow window works now, so let's go home quickly!
tm.「もうちょっと…… もうちょっとだけでがす。\n ……もぐもぐ。: "Just a bit more... just a little more. ...Nom nom.
tm.オジャマロを 倒したことで\nカラーストーンの色が もとに戻った！: Defeating Ojamaro returned the Colorstones' color to normal!
tm.「あれだけの魔物を 倒しちまうなんて\n ……アンタ 見かけによらず 強いんだな: "Defeating that many monsters... you're stronger than you look. You remind me of a friend of mine.
tm.「おっと ムダ話してる場合じゃなかった！\n 早く 帰って ライラの病気を\n: "Oops, no time for idle chat! I must hurry home and cure Lyla's illness!
tm.「それじゃあ 旅人さん 世話になったな。\n 後で ユバールの休息地に来いよ。\: "Well then, traveler, thanks for everything. Come to the Yuval resting place later. I'll thank you properly then.
tm.苦しそうな声が 聞こえる。: A pained voice can be heard.
tm.「ゴホゴホ……苦しい……。\n あなた……助けて……。: "Cough cough... it hurts... Dear... help me...
tm.「ハアハア……苦しい……。\n あなた……。\n ……あなた 助けて……。: "Huff, huff... it hurts... Dear... Dear, help me...
tm.「ハッ！ そこの 強そうな兄ちゃん！\n ちょっと オラの話を聞いてくんろ～！: "Hey, you strong-looking fella! Hear me out, will ya~!
tm.「えらいことに……えらいことになっただよ！\n オラたちのカラーストーンが\n: "It's terrible! Something terrible happened to our Colorstones!
tm.「クチじゃ うまく 説明できねえけど\n とにかく……とにかく えらいことになっ: "I can't explain it well, but it's awful! At this rate, the quarry is finished!
tm.「頼む！ 兄ちゃん！\n 採掘場のどこかにいる 魔物の親玉を倒して\n カラース: "Please, fella! Defeat the monster boss somewhere in the quarry and restore the Colorstone quarry!
tm.「助けてくれたら いいものやるから\n どうか お願いだ。\n オラたちを助けて: "I'll give you something good if you help, so please! Help us~!
tm.「ありがとな 兄ちゃん あんただけが頼りだ！\n 採掘場のどこかにいる 魔物の親: "Thanks, fella! You're our only hope! When you defeat the monster boss in the quarry, tell me!
tm.「よくぞ来た！ チカラ弱き者よ！\n わらわは クイーンマチルダ！: "Well done to come, weakling! I am Queen Matilda!
tm.「宝玉より生まれし ばくだん岩たちは\n かわいい かわいい わらわのしもべぞ！: "The rockbombs born of the gem are my dear, dear servants! Destruction is my delight!
tm.「この採掘場も……そなたも！\n わらわが 壊してしんぜよう！\n フハハハっ！: "This quarry... and you! I shall destroy them! Hahaha! Let us begin!
tm.クイーンマチルダを 倒したことで\nばくだん岩に変わっていた\nカラーストーンが: With Queen Matilda defeated, the Colorstones that had turned into rockbombs are returning to normal...!
tm.カラーストーンを もとに戻した！\n採掘場の入り口にいる\n男性に 伝えにいこう: You restored the Colorstones! Tell the man at the quarry entrance!
tm.「う…… アタマが割れるようだわ。\n 私は いったい 何を……。: "Ugh... my head feels like it's splitting. What was I doing...
tm.「……私の名前は マチルダ。\n 何がなんだか わからないけれど\n あなたが: "...My name is Matilda. I don't know what happened, but you saved me.
tm.「先日 採掘場の見回りをしていたら\n 見なれない魔物と 遭遇しました。\n す: "The other day, while patrolling the quarry, I met an unfamiliar monster. Then it said to me:
tm.「お前のチカラは そんなものではないだろう。\n 破壊こそ お前の望みのはずだ…: "That is not the limit of your power. Destruction is surely your wish... it said.
tm.「その後は よく覚えていないのですが\n 私は 奇妙な魔法をかけられ\n あのよ: "I don't remember much after, but a strange spell was cast on me and I was changed into that terrible form.
tm.「身体の中から わきあがる 破壊の衝動にかられ\n カラーストーンを ばくだん岩: "Driven by a destructive urge surging from within, I turned Colorstones into rockbombs... like a nightmare.
tm.「でも その悪夢から解放され\n こうして 人間の姿に戻れました。\n 私に 人: "But now I'm freed from that nightmare and back in human form. I'm glad my human heart remained.
tm.「すべて あなたのおかげのようですね。\n 名も知らぬ 旅人さん。\n 私を止め: "It seems it was all thanks to you, nameless traveler. Thank you truly for stopping me.
tm.「誰も おめさに こわいことしねえだよ！\n いい子だから 落ち着くだよーっ！！: "Nobody will do scary things to ya! Be a good kid and calm down!!
tm.「た…旅人さん いいところに！\n この子が暴れて 手がつけられねえだ！！\n: "T-traveler, just in time! This one's rampaging and we can't handle it!! Please help!!
tm.「助かるべーっ！！\n かわいそうだけど ガツンとやって\n 追いはらってほしい: "Thank goodness!! Sorry for the poor thing, but please whack it good and drive it off!!
tm.「ありがとう。追いはらってくれて 助かっただ。\n だけど あの子には こまった: "Thank you for driving it off. But that one is trouble... It comes often lately and rampages.
tm.「なつかせようとしても 言うこと聞かねえし\n うちの子たちは すっかり おびえ: "It won't listen even when we try taming it, and our kids are terrified. Lapin House is in danger of closing!
tm.「なあ 旅人さん。あの子が 思わず\n フニャーってなるような 心落ち着くアイテ: "Traveler, if you know an item that calms its heart so it goes 'meow,' could you fetch it?
tm.「んなーっ！ 冷てえこと言わねえで 頼むだ！\n いつでもいいから 心落ち着くア: "Nyaa! Don't be cold, please! Whenever you find an item to calm it, bring it!
tm.「ありがとう 助かるだよ。\n オラは このお屋敷に住む ラパンさまの家来の\n: "Thanks, you saved me. I'm Karatchi, retainer to Lord Lapin who lives in this mansion.
tm.「そういや オラは キラーパンサーを\n 愛するあまり キラーパンサーの言葉が\: "Actually, I love killer panthers so much I can sort of understand their words...
tm.「ひぃぃっ！ おめさ また来ただか！\n 誰も こわいことしねえだ！\n いい子: "Eek! You again?! Nobody will do scary things to ya! Be a good kid and calm down!!
tm.「た…旅人さん 戻ってきてくれただな！\n 何か この子の心が 落ち着くようなも: "T-traveler, you came back! Did you get something to calm this one's heart!?
tm.「この きれいなリボンが そうなんだか！？\n おっし！ こいつに 見せてみるだ: "Is this pretty ribbon it?! Okay! I'll show it to him!!
tm.カラッチは ビアンカのリボンを\nキラーパンサーの 目の前に かざした！: Karatchi held Bianca's ribbon before the killer panther!
tm.キラーパンサーは\nビアンカのリボンの においを かいだ！: The killer panther sniffed Bianca's ribbon!
tm.「な…なんだったんだべ あれは？\n あの子…… まるで 自分の帰る場所を\n: "W-what was that? That one looked like it remembered where it belongs.
tm.「もしかしたら 帰りたいのに\n 帰れなくて 暴れてたのかもしれねえな。\n …: "Maybe it was rampaging because it wanted to go home but couldn't. ...But it's all right now.
tm.「あの子は 大好きな人の所へ\n 帰ったんだべ。おめさのおかげだ。\n お礼に: "It went home to the one it loves. Thanks to you. Please take this as thanks.
tm.「それと…… あのキラーパンサーが 別れ際に\n 合言葉のようなものを 残してい: "And, when parting, that killer panther left something like a password. I'll tell you that too.
tm.呪われし姫君の祭壇の\n夕暮れのラパンハウスが 解放されたようだ。: The Lapin House at Dusk from the Altar of the Cursed Princess seems to be unlocked.
tm.リッカは ルイーダから\n本を受け取り 『王たる者』を読んだ！: Rica received the book from Luida and read "The Mark of a King"!
tm.「王は いかなる時も\n 自分を 見失ってはいけない。: "A king must never lose sight of himself, no matter when.
tm.「王とは 民の父。\n 父として 誇りを失ってはいけない。: "A king is father to his people. As a father, he must never lose his pride.
tm.「父が誇りを失えば 子は悲しむ。\n 子を悲しませる父に 王としての資格なし。: "If a father loses his pride, his children grieve. A father who grieves his children is unfit to be king.
tm.「父が誇りを失えば 子は悲しむ……か。: "If a father loses his pride, his children grieve... huh.
tm.「そうよね 宿王である私の誇りは\n お客さまを 笑顔で迎え入れること……。\n: "Right, as innkeeper queen my pride is welcoming guests with a smile. If I lose that pride, guests will be sad.
tm.「このまま ずっと お客さまを悲しませていたら\n 私は 本当に 宿王の資格を失: "If I'd kept making guests sad, I'd truly have lost my right as innkeeper queen. ...I'd forgotten something important.
tm.「よかった。\n リッカが ちゃんと気づいてくれたわ。\n あの明るい表情を 見: "Good. Rica noticed properly. Look at her bright expression.
tm.「これで リッカは もう大丈夫よ。\n 本当にありがとう。\n 私からの お礼を: "Rica will be fine now. Thank you so much. Would you accept a thank-you from me?
tm.「少女の笑顔を 取り戻すなんて あなたには\n ちいさな出来事かもしれないけど\: "Bringing back a girl's smile may be small to you, but Rica's is a special smile that cheers everyone.
tm.「ピギャアアア！！\n 女神の果実を食べた ボクのチカラを思い知れ！\n すべて: "Pyaaa!! Feel the power of me, who ate the Goddess fruit! I'll destroy everything!!
tm.なんと 終焉竜エンドラゴンは\nスライムに 変化した！: Amazingly, Endragon, Dragon of the End, turned into a slime!
tm.「でも ちょっと調子に乗って\n 大暴れしちゃったような気がするよ……。: "But I got a bit carried away and rampaged too much, I think...
tm.「迷惑をかけたんだったら ごめんね。\n もう二度と こんなことしないから……。: "If I caused trouble, I'm sorry. I'll never do this again. Oh, I'll give this to you!
tm.女神の果実を 手に入れた！\n天使界にいる イザヤールに届けよう！: You got the Goddess fruit! Deliver it to Aquila in the Celestial Realm!
tm.「お母さん！？\n なんで こんな所にいるの！？\n もしかして……: "Mother!? Why are you in a place like this!? Could it be...
tm.「兄さんのカタキ討ちは ムリだと決めつけて\n 私を 連れ戻しにきたのね！\n: "You decided avenging Brother was impossible and came to take me home! No! I'm never going back.
tm.「私は どんなことがあっても\n 絶対に 兄さんのカタキを討つわ。\n それが: "No matter what, I will avenge Brother. It's the path I believe in.
tm.「あなたって子は 本当に\n 私の話を 聞く気がないのね。\n 強情で…… いっ: "You really never listen to me. So stubborn, who do you take after?
tm.「そんなこと言って……\n いつも 私の話を聞いてくれないのは\n お母さんのほ: "You say that... but you're the one who never listens to me, Mother!
tm.「な…なに 笑ってるのよ！\n お母さんは いつだって……: "W-why are you laughing?! Mother, you always...
tm.「ありがとうございました。\n この性格は たしかに うちのゼシカです。\n 気: "Thank you. This personality is indeed our Jessica. It's a humble gift, but please accept it.
tm.「ちょっと どういうことよ。\n 全然 ワケが わからないわ！: "Wait, what's going on? I don't understand any of this!
tm.「うふふ。\n いいのよ わからなくて……。\n もっと ゆっくり 顔を見せてち: "Hehe. It's fine if you don't... Let me look at your face a bit longer.
tm.「本当に お世話になりました。\n ゼシカの旅のお友達から くわしく聞いたところ: "Thank you so much. From Jessica's traveling friends I learned in detail that her odd behavior may be a monster's doing.
tm.{var:1}は\n『ユーモアのほん』を 手に入れた！\n必要な時に 使おう！: {var:1} got the "Book of Humor"! Use it when needed!
tm.{var:1}は\n『おてんばじてん』を 手に入れた！\n必要な時に 使おう！: {var:1} got the "Tomboy Dictionary"! Use it when needed!
tm.「ほほう……。\n また 我がツノの 餌食となる者が現れたか。: "Hoho... another victim for my horn has appeared.
tm.「我が名は ウルトラメタキン！\n この見えざる魔神の道の 支配者なり！: "I am Ultra Metal Kin! Ruler of this path of the unseen demon!
tm.「我は 決して 逃げぬ！\n 冒険者どもに復讐するため あの方のチカラで\n 生: "I never flee! I am the strongest Metal king slime, born by that person's power to take revenge on adventurers!
tm.「欲望を むきだしにした 冒険者どもに\n 執拗に追いまわされる 屈辱の時代は終: "The humiliating era of being doggedly chased by greedy adventurers is over. Now it's the era I strike back!
tm.「ここの宝の地図が 冒険者に広まる限り\n 我の復讐は 終わらぬ！: "As long as the treasure map here spreads among adventurers, my revenge shall not end!
tm.「簡単に 戦いの経験を得ようなどという\n 淡い夢を抱いた ふざけた冒険者は\n: "Foolish adventurers who harbor the faint dream of gaining battle experience easily, I'll sweep them all away!
tm.「い いかん……！\n このままでは 術が…解けて……: "N-no...! At this rate the spell will... break...
tm.「はわわわ～～～ 大変だっ！\n あの方に かけてもらった\n 合体の術が 解け: "Waaah~~ this is bad! The fusion spell that person cast on us broke~~!
tm.「やばい やばいよ～～！\n これじゃ もう すごい呪文が使えない！: "Yikes, yikes~~! Now we can't use the amazing spells!
tm.メタルキングたちは にげだした！: The Metal king slimes ran away!
tm.冒険者たちを 苦しめていた\nウルトラメタキンを 倒した！\n洞くつの入り口にい: You defeated Ultra Metal Kin, who tormented adventurers! Report to the warrior at the cave entrance!
tm.『水の民 ウェディ』\n海に浮かぶ美しい島々で 自由に生きる\n青き水面のような: "The Water Folk: Wetlings" Free dwellers of beautiful sea islands, with bodies the blue of the water's surface.
tm.束縛を嫌い 歌と恋を大切にする彼らは\n速さと 強さという特性を生かして\n愛す: Disliking restraint and treasuring song and love, they fought in earnest only to protect loved ones.
tm.『地の民 ドワーフ』\n雄大な山々に恩恵を受け 大地と共に生きる\n小さな身体に: "The Earth Folk: Dwarves" Dwellers of the mountains, with small bodies and large ears.
tm.高い技術力と 強い欲望を持つ彼らは\n持ち前の 器用さと素早さで\nいくつもの高: With great technical skill and strong desires, they used their dexterity and speed to build many advanced civilizations.
tm.『風の民 エルフ』\n自然を愛し 森と共に生きる\n背に小さな羽を持った かれん: "The Wind Folk: Elves" Lovers of nature in the forest, lovely folk with small wings on their backs.
tm.伝統と格式を重んじる彼らは\n世界の理を 深く学び\n多くの優れた呪文の使い手を: Valuing tradition and propriety, they studied the world's laws deeply and produced many masters of fine spells.
tm.『花の民 プクリポ』\n絵本のような色彩の町で 楽しさを求めて生きる\nふわふわ: "The Flower Folk: Pukulipo" Those who live seeking fun in storybook-colored towns, with small, fluffy, adorable bodies.
tm.強い魔力と 器用さを生まれ持つ彼らは\n戦いより ものを作りだすことより\n楽し: Born with strong magic and dexterity, they devoted their passion to creating fun more than fighting or crafting.
tm.『炎の民 オーガ』\n厳しい荒野で チカラ強く生きる\n大きな身体に ツノと尻尾: "The Flame Folk: Ogres" Those who live strongly in harsh wastelands, large of body with horns and tails.
tm.好戦的で 強き者を尊んだ彼らは\n抜きんでた 強いチカラと体力で\n弱き者や仲間: Combative and respecting the strong, they fought with great strength, risking their lives for the weak and comrades.
tm.緑色のカラーストーンだ。\n小さなカケラが 削りとられた跡がある。: A green Colorstone. A small piece has been chipped away.
tm.カラーストーンは こわれやすいので\nとりあつかいに 注意。: Colorstones break easily, so handle with care.
